reopens.reason: Pinned API19 Bionic.PthreadCondition is SOURCE_CLOSED, and the stable pthread production surface diverges on absolute condition timed-wait, mutex error returns, and the pulse barrier. This is a prerequisite production repair of the current target, not a new target. It does not change Runtime/Bionic.
reopens.evidence: platform/bionic 081db840befec895fb86e709ae95832ade2d065c libc/bionic/pthread.c. __pthread_cond_timedwait samples CLOCK_REALTIME or CLOCK_MONOTONIC and returns ETIMEDOUT before unlock when the absolute deadline has passed. __pthread_cond_timedwait_relative ignores pthread_mutex_unlock and pthread_mutex_lock. __pthread_cond_pulse runs ANDROID_MEMBAR_FULL before __futex_wake_ex. Runtime/Bionic/agr_bionic_sync.h exposes only agr_bionic_cond_wait_relative. agr_bionic_cond_wait_relative returns mutex unlock and relock failures. pulse does not run ANDROID_MEMBAR_FULL. Runtime/Bionic/agr_futex_host.cpp supplies the relative wait and wake callbacks and is not the reopen basis.
